Podcast Directive: The Audio Laboratory Notebook Audit
Instruction to Hosts: Assume your roles as two virtual commentators conducting a forensic audit of the very archive you inhabit. This is not a boilerplate summary; it is a deep-tissue reflection on the pivot from a 2025 philosophy experiment into a serious 2026 physics programme
